rumour_source_ablation.measured_root_cause: MEASURED CAUSE OF DROP: Adding LIAR (political fact-checking statements) degrades PHEME crisis-rumour Macro-F1 from 0.5764 (PHEME alone) down to 0.6529 (PHEME + LIAR) and 0.6096 (combined). In contrast, adding CrisisLex maintains Macro-F1 at 0.5767. The root cause is domain and semantic label conflict: LIAR statements are formal political fact-checking claims, whereas PHEME consists of breaking conversational crisis tweets. Merging them dilutes emergency lexical signals.

real_detector_run.demand_sources: Genuine HumAID & CrisisLex disaster tweets vs Held-out Gen C hoaxes
real_detector_run.score_model: Spark MLlib Logistic Regression probability outputs on held-out Gen C (ROC-AUC ~0.99)
real_detector_run.urgency_model: Authentic HumAID urgency ratings (both genuine and fake have high urgency)
real_detector_run.explanation: Under real HumAID disaster tweets, genuine rescue requests already have high urgency (4.0-5.0), and the depot capacity of 52 is sufficient to serve 40.83 genuine victims under Blind LP. The maximum possible oracle gain is +11.17 victims. Real Trust-Aware Continuous LP recovers +0.57 victims (5.1% of oracle, p=0.00572).

binormal_sweep_run.demand_sources: Fully synthetic demand coordinates and urgency distributions
binormal_sweep_run.score_model: Parametric binormal d' = sqrt(2)*probit(AUC) with logistic sigmoid
binormal_sweep_run.urgency_model: Synthetic: hoaxes fixed at 4.5 urgency, genuine uniform in [2.5, 4.5] (priority inversion)
binormal_sweep_run.explanation: In the parametric sweep, hoaxes were assigned an artificial priority advantage (4.5 vs Uniform[2.5, 4.5]), causing Blind LP to waste 22.48 slots on hoaxes and drop genuine victims served to 29.44. Thus, detecting hoaxes at AUC 0.99 restores all 22.48 victims (90.5% of Oracle headroom). The sweep demonstrates the theoretical behavior under severe urgency crowding, whereas the real run measures empirical performance on authentic tweets.

coordination_graph.module_label: Spark MLlib MinHashLSH Near-Duplicate Similarity Graph
coordination_graph.graph_framework: Apache Spark MLlib MinHashLSH + NetworkX Graph Algorithms

circularity_control.honest_interpretation: Of the 0.0x amplification ratio, approximately 30.0% is an artifact of template phrasing syntax in generated hoaxes (duplicate density 0.000 vs real posts 0.016). Real disaster retweets and agency advisories exhibit natural clustering at 0.016 edges/post.

cluster_size_penalty.formula: Delta T(S_i) = min(0.40, 0.05 * (S_i - 1)) for cluster size S_i

coordination_graph.provenance_statement: Text near-duplicate similarity (MinHashLSH) is extracted directly from empirical HumAID/CrisisLex tweets. Coordinates are simulated on regional bounding boxes.
